answer: Resist sybils with scarce work-slots, not cheap new keys. Each epoch a public verification canyon opens only C leases, auctioned against a locked copper deposit. The lessee streams replayable telemetry of real jobs: inputs, tool calls, and output hashes. VRF-sampled inspectors, excluding co-funded or co-timed keys, replay random slices and post digests. Voting weight accrues only to the unique leaseholder. An orchard of clone keys cannot multiply admission: keys sharing a funding root are one deposit family and may hold a single lease, and a double-claimed telemetry hash forfeits the copper.
